tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam sras rigs can bco lnga'i gtor ma'i rnam gzhag bu tshar sogs mkhas grub kha shas kyi gsung las btus shing ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub dang / ngag dbang chos grags la gtso bor brten pa zhal zas rab gsal bzhugs so// bai3/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi gtor bsham la bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dgos 'dod 'byung ba las thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma phyag len ltar bshams la rta rkyang gi sha dang chang spangs la/ gzhan sha gtsang ma dang dkar gsum gyis brgyan par bshams la zhes gsung la/ bu lugs phyag len la yig cha'i gtso bo bco brgyad pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa las gtor ma phyag len bzhin bsham gsungs pa'i mchan la rgya nag lugs kyi khang brtsegs ma'am/ rgya gar lugs kyi pad gtor ma gang rung byed pa yin zhes gsung / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rnam sras rten gzungs kyi man ngag las gtor ma rgyas pa'i tshe rta bdag gi khang chung yang mdzad la/ rten gtor byed pa'i tshe 'og khang du dud 'gro'i spu sogs rdzas so sor 'jug steng gi cha dang sku mi mdzad/ yig cha phal cher na 'di 'dra 'dug ci min ha ma go bas slar zhu dag dgos yod/ gtor ma khang brtsegs ma lhar bskyed/ nor bu ma 'bul gtor yin/ tshes brgyad rgyun pa'i khang brtsegs/ ma ka 'bul gtor yin no zhes gsung / ngag dbang chos grags kyi rnam sras rigs can bco lnga'i rjes gnang gi yi ge nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan phreng nas gsung pa la/ ༈ 1 /dkar po tshe 'phel gyi skabs su 'bul gtor zlum po/ rten gtor dkar gsum shas che ba las grub pa'i gtor ma khang brtsegs sum rim mar gyi dzaṃ bshos brgyad kyis bskor ba/ ༈ 2 /ser can la rten gtor khang brtsegs ma rgyan ldan/ mar gyi lda ldi drwa ba drwa phyed kyis spras shing /

yu bas ser por kha bsgyur ba mtha' dzaṃ bshos brgyad kyis bskor ba/ 'bul gtor/ ༈ 3 /shu rang gi rnam sras mthing ka yab yum gtso 'khor rten gtor khang bzang / 'bul gtor zlum po/ ༈ 4 /gar mkhan mchog zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa/ lha brgyad la gzhi zlum po/ nyis rim gyi steng nor bu mig gsum gyi steng dzaṃ bshos bzhag pa la nor bu lugs zer/ 'bul gtor/ ༈ 5 /gar mkhan mchog zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa yab yum la gtor ma bshad ma thag pa ltar/ ༈ 6 /dregs byed seng zhon klu brgyad la gtor ma khang bzang rtsi med/ 'bul gtor/ ༈ 7 /dregs byed zhon med klu brgyad la rten gtor gru gsum rtsi nag gam rtsi med gang rung la mda' dar sngon po btsugs pa/ 'bul gtor/ ༈ 8 /yang gsang srin po bzhis bskor la rten gtor rtsa ba zur bzhi/ dpang sor gsum mam de lhag tsam/ de steng gru gsum rtsi nag 'bul gtor zlum dkar/ ༈ 9 /klu sgrub kyi rnam sras mthing nag bdud mo bzhis bskor la gtor ma nor bu lugs/ 'bul gtor/ ༈ 10 /ma mo ltar sgrub pa lha dgu la rten gtor khang bzang 'bul gtor/ ༈ 11 /mdung dmar phyag mtshan bzhi pa la rten gtor gru bzhi mkhar thabs kyi steng gru gsum rtsi dmar 'bul gtor/ ༈ 12 /rnam sras dmar po las mkhan mdung dmar can la rten gtor 'bul gtor zhes pa las dmigs bsal mi snang / ༈ 13 /gsang ba gshin rje ltar sgrub pa lha bcu gsum la rten gtor nor bu lugs smug rtsi can 'bul gtor/ ༈ 14 /sprin gseb ma lha dgu la rten gtor khang bzang ma 'bul gtor/ ༈ 15 /ljang ser be con can la rten gtor ri rab ma 'bul gtor dkar po rnams gsung zhing / 'dir rtsi gsal ka ma gsungs pa rnams la dpe bris na so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i rtsi yod/ 'bul gtor thams cad zlum po yin pa'i lugs su mdzad do/ ༈ /yang mkhan chen zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung rgyun phyag len bu lugs gtsang ma'i chog bsgrigs mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi mdzad byang can rnam sras rigs can bco lnga'i rjes gnang dngos grub 'dod 'jo las gos sngon rjes gnang la zlum gtor gcig

༈ 1 /ser can la rten gtor khang bzang gsum brtsegs rgyan can mda' dar ser po btsugs pa gser gyi sa gzhi'i phyogs mtshams su rta bdag gi gtor chung re dang / de dag gi mtshams rnams su sbrul mjug la rtse gtor ma'i bzo byas pa'i klu brgyad kyi gtor ma dang bcas pa/ de'i mdun du bla ma yi dam la gcig gam so sor re re/ rnam sras la 'bul gtor zlum gtor/ rta rkyang gi sha dang chang spangs la gzhan sha gtsang ma dang dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa bsham/ 'di man la 'bul gtor gsum po de spyi 'grer btang nas/ rten gtor so sor gsungs pa ni/ ༈ 2 /ljang ser be con can la khang brtsegs/ ༈ 3 /shu rang gi lugs gyi mthing kha la rgya gar lugs gyi nor bu ma dang / rgya nag lugs gyi khang brtsegs ma gnyis 'dam kha yin/ nor bu ma ltar na gzhi zlum po gcig gi steng du pad 'dab brgyad/ de steng zlum po gcig gi steng du nor bu mig gsum pa/ de steng gtor ma dngos gzhi dzaṃ bshos gyi dbyibs rtse mo lha bshos kyi rtse mo 'dra ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di la pad lugs nor bu lugs su grags zhes gsungs pa'i mchan la rten gtor khang bzang byed dus/ 'bul gtor nor bu lugs byed gsung / zhwa lu pa'i dkyus kyi phyag len la 'bul gtor zlum po bshos bsang ma mdzad zhes btags/ ༈ 4 /gar mkhan mchog ljang khu la pad lugs nor bu lugs/ ༈ 5 /gar mkhan mchog dmar smug la gzhi zlum po gcig gi steng du de las chung tsam gyi zlum po brtsegs pa'i steng nor bu mig gsum/ de'i steng du sngar bzhin dzaṃ bshos zhal zas gyi rtse mo 'dra ba 'di la nor bu lugs zer/ ༈ 6 /rnam sras dmar po las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa la gdan gru bzhi'i steng mkhar thabs kyi rtser bshos bu gru gsum bzhag pa la smug rtsi byugs rgyan gyis brgyan mda' dar dmar po dang sku tsag tsugs/ ༈ 7 /gsang ba gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa nor bu lugs/

mchod gtor dmar po/ ༈ 8 /dregs byed seng zhon la gru gsum brjid chags pa'i khang bzang / 'bul gtor bla ma yi dam 'dra/ drag po la lcags snod sogs su gtor ma snying gzugs 'bri mog gis byugs pa rgyan ldan zhal zas kyang snying gzugs dmar po/ ༈ 9 /dregs byed zhon med la rjes gnang yod med brtag dpyad mdzad nas gtor ma sogs ma gsung / ༈ 10 /yang gsang srin po bzhis bskor la pad lugs nor bu lugs la ser po byugs zhes gtor ma'i zin bris las 'byung yang sgrub thabs kyi gzhung du rtsa ba gru bzhi dpangs sor gsum lhag tsam pa/ de'i rtser bshos bu gru gsum pa zhig bzhag nag por kha bsgyur rgyan gyis brgyan pa bshad pa bzhin phyag len la mdzad/ 'bul gtor zhal zas dregs byed seng zhon bzhin/ ༈ 11 /bdud mo bzhis bskor la nor bu lugs/ ༈ 12 /ma mo ltar sgrub pa la pad lugs nor bu lugs ma'am/ khang bzang / ༈ 13 /sprin gseb ma la khang bzang mda' dar ser po dang sku tsag btsugs pa bla ma yi dam la zlum gtor/ rnam sras la nor bu lugs/ ༈ 14 /mdung dmar phyag mtshan bzhi pa la rten gtor zhes pa'i mchan la mda' dar dmar po dang sku'i tsakli btsugs zhes btags/ gzhan mchod gtor las mkhan dang bcas pa'i mdung dmar can bzhin bsham zhes zhal 'phangs mdzad/ ༈ 15 /dkar po tshe 'phel la gtor ma khang bzang / zhes pa'i mchan la mda' dar dkar po dang sku tsag btsugs zhes btags/ 'bul gtor zlum po yin gsung / gtor ma rnams kyi skabs su kha dog dang rgyan gsal min sna tshogs gsungs pa ni zhib par phyag len dang tshar lugs phyis kyi bla ma gong ma zhig gis mdzad dam snyam pa'i gtor dpe las rtogs pa'i dbang du mdzad/ phyag len zhib cha bu lugs dang tshar lugs la yod/ gtor dpe rnams na tshon so so'i sku mdog dang mthun zhing rgyan spros ni shin tu rgyas par gda'/ bdag gi bla ma brag rtsa rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi phyag bzo ngo ma yin nam snyam pa'i ser can gyi gtor ma la ri rab gru bzhi phyogs mdog can bang rim gsum pa'i steng phyogs mtshams brgyad du rta bdag gi gtor ma khang chung rgya phibs can phyogs ma rnams kyi phyogs bzhi'i khang chung gi g.yas g.yon du/

phyed bshos rgyan gcig me res bskor ba'i dbus khang pa dang rgya phibs gsum brtsegs/ phyogs mdog mdun ngos ser por mdzad nas g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum la dkar dmar sngo khang brtsegs gsum gyi ldebs la rab gsal dang rgya dkar gyi gzugs/ rgya phibs rtse mo'i dbus rtse rgyan la nyi zla nor bu shing lo sogs mar tshon phra tshom du yod pa zhig gnang / rigs can bco lnga'i gtor ma gzhan rnams kyang ngag chos dang bka' 'gyur ba'i rjes gnang yig cha nas gsungs pa dang phal cher 'dra ba las mi 'dra ba kha re yang snang / lhag par pad lugs nor bu lugs dang / nor bu lugs gnyis khyad cher ma mdzad cing nor bu mig gsum dzaṃ gtor dang bcas pa la rtse nas bzung g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du zan nar zur can sbab le mig gsum ma lta bu re mdzad 'dug kyang dam pa'i phyag len la 'khrul pa ci la mnga'/ khang bzang rnams kyi 'og gzhi ri rab bang rim gsum yod pa 'di dpe bris la 'dug kyang yig cha na ma gsal zhing zhwa lu pa'i phyag len dkyus la'ang mi 'dug des na chog khrigs dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i gzhung de bzhin btsan nam snyam zhing / der mi gsal ba da lta zhwa lu pa'i phyag len la yod pa la gtor snod kyi mthar zan nar rgyun grwas ma gru nar du bskor nas de'i dbus su rnam sras kyi khang bzang de g.yas g.yon du zhengs che ba la/ mdun rgyab du zhengs chung ba zhig mdzad pas gtor ma'i dbyibs brjid ldan zhig yangs ba gda'/ rta bdag gi khang chung sogs ni dngos grub 'dod 'jo bzhin yin/ gong dkar ba rnams zan skyor de'i nang khang brtsegs rnams kyi phyir dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog sogs bzo bkod sna tshogs zhig mdzad 'dug ngor chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi rnam sras bskang ba gnyis mthun par yi dam chos skyong rta bdag brgyad 'khor spyi rnams la che zhing bzang ba'i gtor ma re re'am/

ma 'byor na yi dam chos skyong spyi la re re/ bskang bshags la dgos pa'i khang bzang gi dbyibs su byas pa'i bskang gtor che ba phyag len bzhin dang / zhes gsung nas dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dgongs pa zlum gtor rnams gtor bsngo'i gtor ma dang / khang bzang de bskang ba'i gtor ma yin par mngon zhing / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi bskang ba na bskyed skabs su rigs can bco lnga gsung zhing / shom gyi skabs su chos skyong gi gtor ma gcig gsung ba de rigs can bco lnga la'ang 'thus pa mdzad/ khang bzang de bskang ba'i gtor mar bzhed rgyu yin 'dug kyang / gtor bsngo dang bskang ba la rnam dbye ma gnang bas cung zad go dka' bar 'dug da lta ni cho ga'i babs 'di yin dang / de'i mchod gtor rnam gzhag 'di 'dra yin gyi rtogs dpyod ci yang mi byed par lta ba rang gi grol thub pa kha res yang gnang bas bdag gis zhu ci la spobs/ rang dang 'dra ba'i las dang po pa rnams kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag 'phrul med byed dgos pa ni sdom gsum rab dbye sogs nas gsal ba yin pas bdag gi rjes 'jug rnams mig ldan g.yang mchongs ma mdzad cig ༈ /yang 'jam mgon de nyid kyi sku thog la 'dzugs par mdzad pa'am phyis kyi zhal ngo rnams kyis 'dzugs gnang gang yin kyang gnyer tshang na phyag rdor gyi gtor ma dang / rnam sras rigs can bco lnga'i gtor ma yongs rdzogs zhig 'dug pa 'di dag rten gtor yin na ni 'bul gtor zur du dgos kyang gtor mar lha bskyed chog gi gsal kha med/ des na rigs can bco lnga'i gtor ma 'di yang bskang gtor yin pa ni gong gi 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsung de'i rigs 'gre sbyar bas shes shing / kho bos chog sgrig la bzo bcos byas pa 'di na bskang ba'i skabs su rigs can bco lnga'i gtor ma bsngo ba'ang bshad yod pas da nas de ltar go dgos/ gang ltar yang tig gtor bzhengs byed rgyu la phyag rdor la zlum gtor gcig

ser can la zan skyor gru bzhi pa'i nang khang brtsegs gsum rim gyi rtsa ba'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du rta bdag gi khang chung / 'di rnams la nyis thog dgos pa ni phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs zhes gsungs pa'i go don yin/ phyogs bzhi'i khang chung gi g.yas g.yon du gtor ma sbrul mjug ma re re ste brgyad/ rtse rgyan ni rgyas par na gtor dpe bzhin dang / bsdu na ser rkyang sbrul gtor rnams dkar gtor rtse rgyan gyi dbus su rgyal mtshan/ ༈ /dkar po tshe 'phel la khang brtsegs dkar po gsum gyi mthar zlum gtor brgyad bskor rtse rgyan la rdo rje lcags kyu/ ༈ /rnam sras mthing kha la khang brtsegs mthing kha gsum rim gyi mthar zlum gtor ser po bzhi rtse rgyan la rdo rje rtse lnga/ ༈ /gar mkhan mchog ljang khu la zlum po nyis rim gyi steng gtor zlum bzhag pa nor bu lugs ljang khu rtse rgyan la gser gzhong nor bu'i gang ba/ ༈ /gar mkhan mchog dmar smug la gtor ma de 'dra ba rtsi smug po rtse rgyan gong 'dra/ ༈ /dregs byed seng zhon la gtor ma khang bzang rtsi med kyi mthar zlum gtor brgyad/ rtse rgyan la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa ba dan rtse lnga pa/ ༈ /dregs byed zhon med la gru gsum nag po rtse rgyan gong mtshungs/ ༈ /yang gsang srin po bzhis bskor la rtsa ba gru bzhi dpangs sor gsum lhag tsam gyi khar gru gsum bcas nag po rtse rgyan ral gri/ ༈ /bdud mo bzhis bskor la nor bu lugs nag po rtse rgyan ral gri/ ༈ /ma mo ltar sgrub pa la khang brtsegs gsum rim smug po rtse rgyan ral gri/ ༈ /mdung dmar phyag mtshan bzhi pa la mkhar thabs kyi rtse gru gsum bcas dmar po rtse rgyan mdung mar/ ༈ /yang mdung dmar lugs gcig la gtor ma de kha sor bzhag ༈ /gshin rje ltar sgrub pa la nor bu lugs dmar po rtse rgyan mdung dmar/ ༈ /ljang yul ma la ser can sor bzhag ༈ /ljang ser be con can la ri rab ljang khu bang rim bzhi pa'i rtser dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pa ser po/

g.yas su gdugs g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ ༈ /gtor bsngo'i gtor ma'am mchod gtor rgyas pa ltar na zlum gtor bcu gcig bsdu na gnyis bskang ba la mchod gtor gzabs bsham byed na 'dzugs gtor bzhin/ mi byed na ser can la khang bzang gsum brtsegs/ khang chung brgyad bskor/ ༈ /rigs can bco lnga la nor bu lugs rtsi med gcig bzhengs pas mchod gtor chad lhag med par 'gyur zhing / 'di na da lta'i phyag len la gtor spod skabs zlum gtor grangs mang de dang / rgyun du zlum gtor khang bzang rnams 'dug kyang / zlum gtor grangs mang la dgu las mi 'dug pas gnyis chad/ khang bzang ser can gyi yin pas rigs can bco lnga'i bskang gtor chad pa 'dra mo byung yang 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi gsung bskang na gtor bsngo dang bskang ba'i rnam gzhag cher ma mdzad pas zlum gtor de dag gi sbugs 'gro yin 'dra zhing / da nas 'di bzhin byas na 'gad gtsang / gtor dpe zhib par mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi lugs bzhin 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa 'dis 'thus// //zhes rnam sras gtor ma'i rnam gzhag 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rnam sras rigs can bco lnga'i gtor ma'i rnam gzhag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
